name: Photography & Documentary Support
summary: Support for photographers and documentary makers who need route-aware logistics, local coordination, and time on the ground — not a fixed leisure photo package.
description: Planning for photographers and documentary makers: light-aware pacing, location access, local coordination, and practical ground support. This is a specialist service. We do not advertise a fixed 12-day itinerary, catalog duration, scheduled departures, or a “from” package price.
audience: Photographers, documentary makers, and visual storytellers
planning_notes: Share project goals, preferred regions, sensitivity constraints, gear, and timing. We reply from Kabul with workable options, then a written quotation.
accommodation_note: Best available local hotels, clean and well-located, confirmed during planning.
transport_note: Domestic flights and private vehicles as the brief requires.
support_note: Local guides, drivers, and scheduling support oriented to light, access, and project needs.
availability_note: By proposal — timing depends on season, access, and your brief.

name: Scientific & Research Support
summary: Logistical planning for researchers, academics, and field teams — without a fixed expedition package.
description: We help scope routes, ground transport, lodging, interpreters/fixers, and practical coordination around current access. This is not a tour package: no advertised day count, day-by-day itinerary, scheduled departures, or catalog “from” price.
planning_notes: Share research aims, preferred windows, team size, equipment needs, and any institutional requirements. Access and site conditions are confirmed case by case.
accommodation_note: Best available local hotels, clean and well-located.
transport_note: Domestic flights and 4WD vehicles as scoped.
support_note: Drivers, guides, translators, and local coordination arranged to match the brief where workable.
availability_note: Scheduled by proposal around your window and current operating conditions.

name: Media & Journalist Support
summary: Ground logistics and coordination for journalists and media teams working in Afghanistan.
description: Practical planning for reporters and media crews: transport, lodging, fixer/translator options, and route timing around current conditions. Proposal-led — not a packaged tour.
planning_notes: Contact early with a clear brief (story focus, team size, equipment, deadlines). We scope what is workable; we do not guarantee access to every requested location.
accommodation_note: Hotels accustomed to hosting international visitors where available.
transport_note: Private vehicles with experienced drivers; domestic flights when useful.
support_note: Fixer/translator options and schedule coordination as the brief requires.

name: Business & Investment Visits
summary: Ground support for business visitors, scouting trips, and investment-related travel.
description: Meetings, site visits, and ground logistics coordinated locally around permits and conditions. Specialist planning — not a leisure tour with Day 1–N or a published package price.
planning_notes: Share meeting cities, sector context, group size, and timing. We confirm what is workable; we do not guarantee introductions.
transport_note: Private vehicles; airport meets; intercity options as needed.
support_note: Scheduling support and local coordination for the visit plan.

name: Noshaq Expedition Support
summary: Field logistics support for Noshaq and related high-altitude expedition teams — scoped to the climb brief, not sold as a fixed catalog tour.
description: Mountaineering and remote-access logistics: transport into Badakhshan/Wakhan corridors when workable, lodging, local coordination, and support scaled to the expedition brief. This is specialist fieldwork support. We do not advertise a fixed 21-day tourist itinerary, scheduled leisure departures, or a catalog “from” package price.
planning_notes: Share objectives, experience level, season, team size, and support expectations. We confirm feasibility honestly around current access and conditions.
accommodation_note: Mix of hotels and field arrangements as scoped.
transport_note: Flights, 4WD, and specialist arrangements as required by the brief.
support_note: Local support, porters/animals, and coordination scaled to the expedition.

name: Ski Expedition Support
summary: Proposal-led support for ski and snow-travel projects beyond our published Bamyan Skiing Tour.
description: Custom ski and winter-field logistics planned around snow conditions, access, and your objectives. Distinct from the fixed-itinerary Bamyan Skiing Tour. No advertised fixed duration, Day 1–N package, or catalog “from” price for this specialist support track.
audience: Skiers and winter expedition teams seeking bespoke support
planning_notes: Share ability level, preferred massifs or valleys, timing, and group size. We scope what is workable for the season.
transport_note: 4WD and seasonal access arrangements as required.
support_note: Local coordination matched to winter travel realities.
